1Paulo a ɔnam Nyankopɔn pɛ so yɛ Kristo Yesu somafoɔ, ne onua Timoteo 2#Rom 1.7 de kɔma anuanom, ahotefoɔ ne agyidifoɔ wɔ Kristo mu, a wɔwɔ Kolose: Adom ne asomdwoeɛ a ɛfiri yɛn Agya Nyankopɔn nka mo.
Aseda
3Da biara a yɛbɔ mpaeɛ ma mo no, yɛda Onyankopɔn, yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo n’Agya ase, 4#Efe 1.15 ɛfiri sɛ yɛate mo Kristo Yesu mu gyidie ne mo dɔ a mode dɔ ahotefoɔ nyinaa, 5ɛsiane anidasoɔ a ɛda hɔ ma mo wɔ ɔsoro, ɛno na monam asɛmpa nokwasɛm so dii kan teɛ. 6Asɛmpa no na aba mo nkyɛn, sɛdeɛ ɛwɔ wiase nyinaa nso, na ɛreso aba na ɛkɔ so nyini, sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ wɔ mo mu nso firi da a moteeɛ na mohunuu Nyankopɔn adom nokorɛ mu no, 7#Kol 4.12 sɛdeɛ mosuaeɛ nso firii yɛn awurakwaa dɔfo Epafra a ɔyɛ mo Kristo somfo nokwafoɔ 8a wabɛyi mo honhom mu dɔ akyerɛ yɛn nso nkyɛn no.
Wɔn honhom fam nkɔsoɔ ho adesrɛ
9 # Efe 1.16-17 Yei nti yɛn nso, ɛfiri da a yɛteeɛ no, yɛnnyaee mo tiri so mpaebɔ ne nkotosrɛ, sɛ ne pɛ mu nimdeɛ nhyɛ mo ma, honhom nyansa ne nteaseɛ nyinaa mu, 10#Efe 4.1; Flp 1.27; 1 Ko 1.5 na moanante sɛdeɛ ɛfata Awurade na ɛsɔ n’ani koraa, na moaso adwuma pa nyinaa mu aba, na moanyini akɔ Nyankopɔn ho nimdeɛ mu. 11Na ama wɔde tumi nyinaa ahyɛ mo den, sɛdeɛ n’animuonyam tumidie teɛ no, akɔ boasetɔ ne abodwokyɛre nyinaa mu wɔ anigyeɛ mu, 12#Efe 1.11 na yɛada Agya a wama yɛafata ahotefoɔ apɛgyadeɛ no fafafoɔ wɔ hann mu no ase, 13#Kol 2.15 sɛ wayi yɛn afiri sum tumi ase de yɛn aba ne Dɔba no ahennie mu. 14#Efe 1.7 Ɔno mu na yɛanya ɔgyeɛ ne bɔne fakyɛ.
Kristo yɛ Nyankopɔn suban ne abɔdeɛ nyinaa so wura
15 # Heb 1.3 Ɔno ara na ɔyɛ Onyankopɔn a wɔnhu no no nsɛso ne abɔdeɛ nyinaa farebae, 16#Yoh 1.3; 1.10 ɛfiri sɛ ne mu na wɔbɔɔ nnoɔma nyinaa, deɛ ɛwɔ soro ne deɛ ɛwɔ asase soɔ, deɛ wɔhunu ne deɛ wɔnhunu, nhennwa oo, wuradie oo, mpaninnie oo, tumidie oo, nnoɔma no nyinaa, wɔnam ne so na ɛbɔeɛ, na wɔbɔ maa no. 17#Mmb 8.25-27 Na ɔno na ɔyɛ adeɛ nyinaa kannifoɔ, na nnoɔma nyinaa atim wɔ ne mu.
Kristo yɛ asafo no ti
18 # Efe 1.22; Aso 26.23; Adi 1.5 Na ɔno ne nipadua a ɛyɛ asafo no tire; ɔno ne mfitiaseɛ, awufosɔreɛ mu farebae, sɛ ɔnnyɛ ade nyinaa mu kannifoɔ. 19#Kol 2.9; Yoh 1.16 Ɛfiri sɛ ɛsɔɔ Nyankopɔn ani sɛ ne mayɛ nyinaa bɛtena ne mu, 20#Efe 1.10; 1 Yoh 2.2 na ɔnam ne so apata Onyankopɔn ne nnoɔma nyinaa ntam koraa. Ɛne sɛ, ɔnam n’asɛnnua ho mogya so ayɛ asomdwoeɛ nam ɔno ara so apata nnoɔma nyinaa, asase so deɛ oo, ɔsoro deɛ oo, ne Onyankopɔn ntam.
Nkwagyeɛ a ɛnam Kristo so ba
21 # Efe 2.12; 4.18; Rom 5.10 Na mo nso a anka moyɛ atuatefoɔ ne atamfoɔ, adwene fam ne nnwuma bɔne mu no, 22#Efe 5.27 afei ɔnam owuo so apata mo ne no ntam wɔ ne honam nipadua mu, sɛ ɔde mo bɛsi hɔ sɛ nnipa kronkron a wɔnni dɛm a asɛm bi nni wɔn ho wɔ n’anim; 23nanso gye sɛ mokɔ so ara tena gyidie no mu, gyina mo fapem no so pintinn a momma wɔntwe mo mfiri asɛmpa no anidasoɔ a moteeɛ a wɔaka no wiase abɔdeɛ nyinaa mu, a me Paulo mayɛ ho somfoɔ no ho.
Ɔsomafoɔ no amanehunu
24 # Efe 3.13 Afei m’ani gye amaneɛ a mehunu mema mo no mu, na mehyɛ Kristo amanehunu, deɛ aka no ananmu, wɔ me honam mu mema ne nipadua a ɛyɛ asafo no 25a mayɛ ne somfoɔ, sɛdeɛ Nyankopɔn fiehwɛdwuma no teɛ. Yei na wɔde ama me wɔ mo famu, sɛ mehyɛ Nyankopɔn asɛm no ma. 26#Rom 16.25-26 Aane, ahuntasɛm no a ɛfiri mmeresanten ne awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ so huntaeɛ no, afei wayi no adi akyerɛ n’ahotefoɔ. 27#1 Ti 1.1 Onyankopɔn pɛ sɛ ɔma n’ahotefoɔ hunu ahuntasɛm yi animuonyam ahonya wɔ amanaman mu, a ɛne Kristo a ɔwɔ mo mu, animuonyam anidasoɔ no. 28#Kol 1.22 Ɔno na yɛbɔ no dawuro, yɛkasa kyerɛ onipa biara, na yɛkyerɛkyerɛ ankorankorɛ biara nyansa nyinaa mu, sɛ yɛde obiara bɛsi hɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ Kristo mu. 29Ɛno ho nso na meyɛ adwuma mebrɛ, na medi aperepereɛ, sɛdeɛ n’ahoɔden adwuma a ɔyɛ no me mu tumi soɔ no teɛ.

pageProps.chapterText:
Paulo a ɔnam Nyankopɔn pɛ so yɛ Kristo Yesu somafoɔ, ne onua Timoteo de kɔma anuanom, ahotefoɔ ne agyidifoɔ wɔ Kristo mu, a wɔwɔ Kolose: Adom ne asomdwoeɛ a ɛfiri yɛn Agya Nyankopɔn nka mo.

Da biara a yɛbɔ mpaeɛ ma mo no, yɛda Onyankopɔn, yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo n’Agya ase, ɛfiri sɛ yɛate mo Kristo Yesu mu gyidie ne mo dɔ a mode dɔ ahotefoɔ nyinaa, ɛsiane anidasoɔ a ɛda hɔ ma mo wɔ ɔsoro, ɛno na monam asɛmpa nokwasɛm so dii kan teɛ. Asɛmpa no na aba mo nkyɛn, sɛdeɛ ɛwɔ wiase nyinaa nso, na ɛreso aba na ɛkɔ so nyini, sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ wɔ mo mu nso firi da a moteeɛ na mohunuu Nyankopɔn adom nokorɛ mu no, sɛdeɛ mosuaeɛ nso firii yɛn awurakwaa dɔfo Epafra a ɔyɛ mo Kristo somfo nokwafoɔ a wabɛyi mo honhom mu dɔ akyerɛ yɛn nso nkyɛn no.

Yei nti yɛn nso, ɛfiri da a yɛteeɛ no, yɛnnyaee mo tiri so mpaebɔ ne nkotosrɛ, sɛ ne pɛ mu nimdeɛ nhyɛ mo ma, honhom nyansa ne nteaseɛ nyinaa mu, na moanante sɛdeɛ ɛfata Awurade na ɛsɔ n’ani koraa, na moaso adwuma pa nyinaa mu aba, na moanyini akɔ Nyankopɔn ho nimdeɛ mu. Na ama wɔde tumi nyinaa ahyɛ mo den, sɛdeɛ n’animuonyam tumidie teɛ no, akɔ boasetɔ ne abodwokyɛre nyinaa mu wɔ anigyeɛ mu, na yɛada Agya a wama yɛafata ahotefoɔ apɛgyadeɛ no fafafoɔ wɔ hann mu no ase, sɛ wayi yɛn afiri sum tumi ase de yɛn aba ne Dɔba no ahennie mu. Ɔno mu na yɛanya ɔgyeɛ ne bɔne fakyɛ.

Ɔno ara na ɔyɛ Onyankopɔn a wɔnhu no no nsɛso ne abɔdeɛ nyinaa farebae, ɛfiri sɛ ne mu na wɔbɔɔ nnoɔma nyinaa, deɛ ɛwɔ soro ne deɛ ɛwɔ asase soɔ, deɛ wɔhunu ne deɛ wɔnhunu, nhennwa oo, wuradie oo, mpaninnie oo, tumidie oo, nnoɔma no nyinaa, wɔnam ne so na ɛbɔeɛ, na wɔbɔ maa no. Na ɔno na ɔyɛ adeɛ nyinaa kannifoɔ, na nnoɔma nyinaa atim wɔ ne mu.

Na ɔno ne nipadua a ɛyɛ asafo no tire; ɔno ne mfitiaseɛ, awufosɔreɛ mu farebae, sɛ ɔnnyɛ ade nyinaa mu kannifoɔ. Ɛfiri sɛ ɛsɔɔ Nyankopɔn ani sɛ ne mayɛ nyinaa bɛtena ne mu, na ɔnam ne so apata Onyankopɔn ne nnoɔma nyinaa ntam koraa. Ɛne sɛ, ɔnam n’asɛnnua ho mogya so ayɛ asomdwoeɛ nam ɔno ara so apata nnoɔma nyinaa, asase so deɛ oo, ɔsoro deɛ oo, ne Onyankopɔn ntam.

Na mo nso a anka moyɛ atuatefoɔ ne atamfoɔ, adwene fam ne nnwuma bɔne mu no, afei ɔnam owuo so apata mo ne no ntam wɔ ne honam nipadua mu, sɛ ɔde mo bɛsi hɔ sɛ nnipa kronkron a wɔnni dɛm a asɛm bi nni wɔn ho wɔ n’anim; nanso gye sɛ mokɔ so ara tena gyidie no mu, gyina mo fapem no so pintinn a momma wɔntwe mo mfiri asɛmpa no anidasoɔ a moteeɛ a wɔaka no wiase abɔdeɛ nyinaa mu, a me Paulo mayɛ ho somfoɔ no ho.

Afei m’ani gye amaneɛ a mehunu mema mo no mu, na mehyɛ Kristo amanehunu, deɛ aka no ananmu, wɔ me honam mu mema ne nipadua a ɛyɛ asafo no a mayɛ ne somfoɔ, sɛdeɛ Nyankopɔn fiehwɛdwuma no teɛ. Yei na wɔde ama me wɔ mo famu, sɛ mehyɛ Nyankopɔn asɛm no ma. Aane, ahuntasɛm no a ɛfiri mmeresanten ne awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ so huntaeɛ no, afei wayi no adi akyerɛ n’ahotefoɔ. Onyankopɔn pɛ sɛ ɔma n’ahotefoɔ hunu ahuntasɛm yi animuonyam ahonya wɔ amanaman mu, a ɛne Kristo a ɔwɔ mo mu, animuonyam anidasoɔ no. Ɔno na yɛbɔ no dawuro, yɛkasa kyerɛ onipa biara, na yɛkyerɛkyerɛ ankorankorɛ biara nyansa nyinaa mu, sɛ yɛde obiara bɛsi hɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ Kristo mu. Ɛno ho nso na meyɛ adwuma mebrɛ, na medi aperepereɛ, sɛdeɛ n’ahoɔden adwuma a ɔyɛ no me mu tumi soɔ no teɛ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
